claim_text: High-dose beta-carotene supplements should not be recommended for cancer or cardiovascular disease prevention; evidence summarized by NCCIH and the USPSTF identifies increased lung-cancer risk in smokers and people exposed to asbestos.
health_goal_or_outcome: Cancer and cardiovascular disease prevention; supplement-related harms

population.age_range: As specified in the underlying source; not generalized beyond studied populations.
population.health_status: Not a diagnosis or individualized treatment recommendation.
population.other_context: Claim scope restricted to the cited outcome and source population.

ingredient_form_or_preparation: See source-specific form and preparation; do not assume equivalence across products.
evidence_summary: Preliminary source-linked claim extracted from the registered literature and regulator materials; full text appraisal and claim-level review remain pending.
limitations: This does not apply to beta-carotene naturally present in foods in the same way.
Risk is particularly relevant to smokers and asbestos-exposed populations.
Do not use this ingredient as a generic antioxidant recommendation.
